package.name: nros_fingerprint_probe
package.description:
Issue RFC-0061 / phase-318 W1 — the probe corpus whose EMITTED BYTES define the codegen fingerprint. It is not a test package and nothing links it: its only job is to exercise every emitter branch whose output can change, so that `codegen-fingerprint.sh` moves if and only if generated code would move.
Adding a shape here is cheap and safe. REMOVING one silently narrows what the fingerprint can notice, so treat deletions as you would deleting a test.
